q: 我答应过他要去看比赛，可是临时有事，结果___去成。
zh: 我答应过他要去看比赛，可是临时有事，结果没去成。
py: wǒ dā ying guo tā yào qù kàn bǐ sài kě shì lín shí yǒu shì jié guǒ méi qù chéng
en: I promised him I'd go to the match, but something came up and in the end I didn't get to go.
why: 结果 reports what actually turned out, so 没去成 (did not manage to go). 不去成 is not a form.

q: 昨天下大雨，我___想出去跑步。
zh: 昨天下大雨，我不想出去跑步。
py: zuó tiān xià dà yǔ wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù pǎo bù
en: It rained hard yesterday and I didn't feel like going out for a run.
why: 想 (feel like) is a wish, so it takes 不 even for yesterday. 没 would deny an event rather than a wish.

zh: 这家店春节期间不开门。
py: zhè jiā diàn chūn jié qī jiān bù kāi mén
en: This shop is not open during Spring Festival.
why: A regular closing is a plan or habit, so 不 goes before 开门. 不 stays after the time phrase.

zh: 比赛还没开始。
py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ
en: The match hasn't started yet.
why: 还 comes before 没: 还没 + verb means 'not yet'. 没还 is not possible.

q: 这个球太高了，我接___到。
zh: 这个球太高了，我接不到。
py: zhè ge qiú tài gāo le wǒ jiē bù dào
en: This ball is too high; I can't catch it.
why: 'Cannot' with a result complement puts 不 between the verb and the result: 接不到. 接没到 is not a form.

q: 我平时___去健身房，只有周末才去。
zh: 我平时不去健身房，只有周末才去。
py: wǒ píng shí bù qù jiàn shēn fáng zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò cái qù
en: I don't usually go to the gym; I only go on weekends.
why: 平时 plus 只有周末才去 describes a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one occasion that did not happen.

q: 他还___起床呢，比赛十点才开始。
zh: 他还没起床呢，比赛十点才开始。
py: tā hái méi qǐ chuáng ne bǐ sài shí diǎn cái kāi shǐ
en: He hasn't got up yet; the match only starts at ten.
why: 还...呢 means 'not yet', which is 没 + verb. 不起床 would say he refuses to get up.

q: 那场比赛我们输得很惨，一个球也没进___。
zh: 那场比赛我们输得很惨，一个球也没进。
py: nà chǎng bǐ sài wǒ men shū de hěn cǎn yī ge qiú yě méi jìn
en: We lost that match badly; we didn't score a single goal.
why: 没进 reports a goal that never happened, so there is no 了 after it.

src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le cái pàn de huà
zh: 我没听懂裁判的话。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng cái pàn de huà
en: I didn't understand what the referee said.
why: A result that was not reached is 没 + verb + result, and 了 is dropped. 不听懂 is not a form.

q: 孩子们，___在冰上跑，很危险！
zh: 孩子们，别在冰上跑，很危险！
py: hái zi men bié zài bīng shàng pǎo hěn wēi xiǎn
en: Children, don't run on the ice; it's dangerous!
why: Prohibition is 别 + verb. 不用 would only say 'no need to run' and 没 cannot give an order.

q: 小时候我___喜欢游泳，长大后才爱上它。
zh: 小时候我不喜欢游泳，长大后才爱上它。
py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ bù xǐ huan yóu yǒng zhǎng dà hòu cái ài shàng tā
en: I didn't like swimming as a child; I only came to love it when I grew up.
why: 喜欢 is a state verb and is negated with 不 whatever the time. 没喜欢 is not said.

zh: 我不会打网球。
py: wǒ bù huì dǎ wǎng qiú
en: I can't play tennis.
why: 不 attaches to the modal 会 in front of the main verb: 不会打. 会不打 would change the meaning and 打不会 is not a form.

s: 我没会滑雪。
zh: 我不会滑雪。
py: wǒ bù huì huá xuě
en: I can't ski.
why: 会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 is never possible.

s: 我昨天不去看球赛。
zh: 我昨天没去看球赛。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù kàn qiú sài
en: I didn't go to the match yesterday.
why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没去. 不去 looks forward or expresses refusal.
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bù qù kàn qiú sài

q: 不管大家怎么劝，他就是___参加今年的龙舟比赛。
zh: 不管大家怎么劝，他就是不参加今年的龙舟比赛。
py: bù guǎn dà jiā zěn me quàn tā jiù shì bù cān jiā jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài
en: No matter how everyone urges him, he simply refuses to take part in this year's dragon boat race.
why: 就是 after 不管...劝 expresses stubborn refusal, and refusal is 不. 别 is an order to someone else and cannot have 他 as its subject.

q: 我以前___知道这个节日的来历。
zh: 我以前不知道这个节日的来历。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào zhè ge jié rì de lái lì
en: I didn't know the origin of this festival before.
why: 知道 is a state verb, so it takes 不 even for the past: 以前不知道. 没知道 is not a normal phrase.

zh: 我不喜欢爬山。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huan pá shān
en: I don't like hiking.
why: 喜欢 is a state verb, so 不 goes directly before it: 不喜欢. 喜欢不 is not a form.

q: 我找了半天，也___找到我的球拍，可能落在比赛场地了。
zh: 我找了半天，也没找到我的球拍，可能落在比赛场地了。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qiú pāi kě néng là zài bǐ sài chǎng dì le
en: I searched for ages and still didn't find my racket; I may have left it at the match venue.
why: 找了半天 is a past search that did not reach its result: 没找到. 不找到 is not a statement; 找不到 would say 'can't find'.

s: 过完年，我们没有时间踢球了。
zh: 过完年，我们没有时间踢球了。
py: guò wán nián wǒ men méi yǒu shí jiān tī qiú le
en: After the New Year we won't have time to play football any more.
why: 没有...了 means 'no longer have'. The 了 marks a change of situation, not a completed action, so it is correct with 没有.

q: 比赛的时候，你___说话！
zh: 比赛的时候，你别说话！
py: bǐ sài de shí hou nǐ bié shuō huà
en: Don't talk during the match!
why: An order needs 别 or 不要 before the verb. 你不说话 only states that you are not talking, and 没 looks back.

q: 我已经买好票了，你___买了。
zh: 我已经买好票了，你不用买了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo piào le nǐ bù yòng mǎi le
en: I've already bought the tickets; you don't need to buy any.
why: 不用 means 'there is no need to'. 没有 and 不会 cannot be followed by a bare verb to say that.

q: 刚才进球的时候，我___在看比赛，所以没看到。
zh: 刚才进球的时候，我没在看比赛，所以没看到。
py: gāng cái jìn qiú de shí hou wǒ méi zài kàn bǐ sài suǒ yǐ méi kàn dào
en: I wasn't watching the match when the goal was scored, so I didn't see it.
why: 没在 + verb denies that an action was in progress at that past moment, matching 没看到 after it. 不在看 is not the usual negation of a progressive and does not fit a specific moment.

q: 因为下大雨，今年的龙舟比赛没有举行___，大家都很失望。
zh: 因为下大雨，今年的龙舟比赛没有举行，大家都很失望。
py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài méi yǒu jǔ xíng dà jiā dōu hěn shī wàng
en: Because of heavy rain, this year's dragon boat race wasn't held, and everyone was disappointed.
why: 没有举行 negates a completed event, so 了 is dropped. The comma after it starts a new clause with its own meaning.

q: 弟弟今天早上没去游泳___。
zh: 弟弟今天早上没去游泳。
py: dì di jīn tiān zǎo shang méi qù yóu yǒng
en: My younger brother didn't go swimming this morning.
why: A negated past action takes 没 without 了. Adding 了 would wrongly mix 'it happened' with 'it did not happen'.

zh: 我没看懂这场比赛的规则。
py: wǒ méi kàn dǒng zhè chǎng bǐ sài de guī zé
en: I didn't understand the rules of this match.
why: 没 goes before the verb + result 看懂 to say the result was not reached. 看没懂 is not possible.

q: 今天___比赛，大家都在家休息。
zh: 今天没有比赛，大家都在家休息。
py: jīn tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài dà jiā dōu zài jiā xiū xi
en: There is no match today; everyone is resting at home.
why: 有 is negated only with 没: 没有比赛. 不有 does not exist, and 不是比赛 would not mean 'there is none'.

q: 明天我们在家看比赛，你___早起，睡个懒觉吧。
zh: 明天我们在家看比赛，你不用早起，睡个懒觉吧。
py: míng tiān wǒ men zài jiā kàn bǐ sài nǐ bù yòng zǎo qǐ shuì ge lǎn jiào ba
en: We're watching the match at home tomorrow; you don't need to get up early, so sleep in.
why: The point is that early rising is unnecessary, which is 不用. 没 looks back at the past and 不是 negates a noun or 是.

zh: 你别在这里放鞭炮。
py: nǐ bié zài zhè lǐ fàng biān pào
en: Don't set off firecrackers here.
why: 别 comes before the whole verb phrase: 别 + 在这里 + 放鞭炮. 放鞭炮别 is not a form.

zh: 他腿受伤了，所以不能参加比赛。
py: tā tuǐ shòu shāng le suǒ yǐ bù néng cān jiā bǐ sài
en: His leg is injured, so he can't take part in the match.
why: 不 goes before the modal 能, not before 参加. 所以 starts the result clause.

src_py: tā mǎi le nà zhāng qiú piào
zh: 他没买那张球票。
py: tā méi mǎi nà zhāng qiú piào
en: He didn't buy that match ticket.
why: The negative of 买了 is 没买, with 了 removed. 没买了 is the classic error.

q: 我___会滑冰，只会滑雪。
zh: 我不会滑冰，只会滑雪。
py: wǒ bù huì huá bīng zhǐ huì huá xuě
en: I can't skate; I can only ski.
why: 会 is a modal verb and 不 goes in front of it. 没会 is not possible.

s: 去年的球票没贵。
zh: 去年的球票不贵。
py: qù nián de qiú piào bù guì
en: Last year's match tickets weren't expensive.
why: 贵 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even about last year. 没贵 is not a phrase.
s_py: qù nián de qiú piào méi guì

q: 对不起，我昨天___给你打电话。
zh: 对不起，我昨天没给你打电话。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: Sorry, I didn't call you yesterday.
why: 昨天 plus 打电话 is a specific action that did not occur: 没. 不打 would be a refusal to call.

q: 我家附近___公园，我只能在家锻炼。
zh: 我家附近没有公园，我只能在家锻炼。
py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng yuán wǒ zhǐ néng zài jiā duàn liàn
en: There is no park near my home, so I can only exercise at home.
why: Non-existence is 没有. 不有 is never said, and 不是公园 would claim that something nearby is not a park.

q: 我___觉得今年的灯会比去年热闹。
zh: 我不觉得今年的灯会比去年热闹。
py: wǒ bù jué de jīn nián de dēng huì bǐ qù nián rè nao
en: I don't think this year's lantern festival is livelier than last year's.
why: 觉得 gives an opinion and takes 不. 没 cannot negate an opinion, and 别 is only for commands.

q: 圣诞节那天我们___去商场，一直在家包饺子。
zh: 圣诞节那天我们没去商场，一直在家包饺子。
py: shèng dàn jié nà tiān wǒ men méi qù shāng chǎng yī zhí zài jiā bāo jiǎo zi
en: On Christmas Day we didn't go to the mall; we stayed home making dumplings.
why: 一直在家 reports what actually happened that day, so the negative is 没. 不去 would be a plan or refusal.

q: 这只是朋友间的小比赛，你___太紧张，放松一点。
zh: 这只是朋友间的小比赛，你不要太紧张，放松一点。
py: zhè zhǐ shì péng you jiān de xiǎo bǐ sài nǐ bú yào tài jǐn zhāng fàng sōng yī diǎn
en: This is only a small match between friends; don't be too nervous, relax a bit.
why: 不要 + verb is a command, 'don't be so nervous'. 没 and 不是 cannot start a command.

q: 今年的龙舟比赛，我们队___有足够的人，只好放弃了。
zh: 今年的龙舟比赛，我们队没有足够的人，只好放弃了。
py: jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài wǒ men duì méi yǒu zú gòu de rén zhǐ hǎo fàng qì le
en: Our team doesn't have enough people for this year's dragon boat race, so we have to give up.
why: 没有足够的人 negates 有 with 没. 不有 does not exist, even in a sentence about a decision or a plan.

q: 这些月饼太多了，我们吃___完。
zh: 这些月饼太多了，我们吃不完。
py: zhè xiē yuè bing tài duō le wǒ men chī bù wán
en: There are too many mooncakes; we can't finish them.
why: Cannot manage to finish = 吃不完, with 不 between verb and result. 吃没完 is not said.

s: 他昨天没在家，去看龙舟比赛了。
zh: 他昨天没在家，去看龙舟比赛了。
py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài le
en: He wasn't at home yesterday; he went to watch the dragon boat race.
why: 没在 + place is accepted, especially about the past. The 了 belongs to the second clause 去看...了, a completed action, not to the negated one.

zh: 我从来没参加过马拉松。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng
en: I have never taken part in a marathon.
why: 从来没 + verb + 过 is the standard pattern for an experience never had. 没 comes after 从来, and 过 must stay on the verb.

s: 春节的时候，爷爷从来不玩手机。
zh: 春节的时候，爷爷从来不玩手机。
py: chūn jié de shí hou yé ye cóng lái bù wán shǒu jī
en: At Spring Festival Grandpa never plays with his phone.
why: 从来不 + verb states a standing habit. 不 is correct here, and 没 would need 过: 从来没玩过.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù tī zú qiú le
zh: 我昨天没去踢足球。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù tī zú qiú
en: I didn't go to play football yesterday.
why: Negating a completed action: put 没 before the verb and drop 了. 不去 would mean a refusal or a plan.

q: 明年夏天我___有时间去参加马拉松，要出差。
zh: 明年夏天我没有时间去参加马拉松，要出差。
py: míng nián xià tiān wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān qù cān jiā mǎ lā sōng yào chū chāi
en: Next summer I won't have time to run in the marathon; I have a business trip.
why: 有 is negated with 没 in the future too: 没有时间. 不有 is impossible, however far ahead the time word points.

q: 我昨天没踢足球___。
zh: 我昨天没踢足球。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi tī zú qiú
en: I didn't play football yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so the completion 了 has nothing to mark and must be left out.

s: 你没应该在比赛前喝酒。
zh: 你不应该在比赛前喝酒。
py: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài bǐ sài qián hē jiǔ
en: You shouldn't drink alcohol before a match.
why: 应该 is a modal verb and takes 不. 没应该 does not exist.
s_py: nǐ méi yīng gāi zài bǐ sài qián hē jiǔ

q: 你昨天怎么___来看球赛？我们等了你很久。
zh: 你昨天怎么没来看球赛？我们等了你很久。
py: nǐ zuó tiān zěn me méi lái kàn qiú sài wǒ men děng le nǐ hěn jiǔ
en: Why didn't you come to the match yesterday? We waited a long time for you.
why: The question is about something that did not happen yesterday, so 没来. 怎么不来 asks why someone is not coming at all, a habit or plan.

s: 明天我不有比赛。
zh: 明天我没有比赛。
py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu bǐ sài
en: I don't have a match tomorrow.
why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, even for tomorrow; 不有 does not exist.
s_py: míng tiān wǒ bù yǒu bǐ sài

q: 我们等了一个小时，他还是___来。
zh: 我们等了一个小时，他还是没来。
py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā hái shi méi lái
en: We waited an hour and he still didn't come.
why: The sentence reports what did not happen after an hour of waiting: 没来. 不来 would say he refuses to come.

q: 他没买月饼，买___两盒茶叶。
zh: 他没买月饼，买了两盒茶叶。
py: tā méi mǎi yuè bing mǎi le liǎng hé chá yè
en: He didn't buy mooncakes; he bought two boxes of tea instead.
why: Only the 没 half drops 了. The positive half is a completed action with a counted object, so 了 goes right after the verb.

s: 照片太小了，我看没清楚。
zh: 照片太小了，我看不清楚。
py: zhào piàn tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
en: The photo is too small; I can't see it clearly.
why: 'Cannot' with a complement is verb + 不 + result: 看不清楚. 没 cannot sit between a verb and its result.
s_py: zhào piàn tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn méi qīng chu

q: 这个粽子我还___吃，你先别拿走。
zh: 这个粽子我还没吃，你先别拿走。
py: zhè ge zòng zi wǒ hái méi chī nǐ xiān bié ná zǒu
en: I haven't eaten this zongzi yet; don't take it away yet.
why: 还没 + verb means 'not yet', the action has not happened up to now. 还不吃 would suggest a refusal to eat.

q: 这场比赛的票太贵了，我买___起。
zh: 这场比赛的票太贵了，我买不起。
py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài de piào tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: The tickets for this match are too expensive; I can't afford them.
why: 买不起 is the potential form 'cannot afford', with 不 between verb and complement. 买没起 does not exist.

q: 声音太小了，我听___清楚裁判说什么。
zh: 声音太小了，我听不清楚裁判说什么。
py: shēng yīn tài xiǎo le wǒ tīng bù qīng chu cái pàn shuō shén me
en: The sound is too low; I can't hear what the referee is saying.
why: 听不清楚 means 'cannot hear clearly', with 不 inside the verb-complement. 听没清楚 is not a form.

s: 昨天我请他去爬山，他不去。
zh: 昨天我请他去爬山，他不去。
py: zuó tiān wǒ qǐng tā qù pá shān tā bù qù
en: I invited him to go hiking yesterday, but he wouldn't go.
why: 不 about a past moment expresses refusal at that time, which is the meaning here. 没去 would only report that he did not go.

q: 他___是我们的篮球教练，他是体育老师。
zh: 他不是我们的篮球教练，他是体育老师。
py: tā bù shì wǒ men de lán qiú jiào liàn tā shì tǐ yù lǎo shī
en: He isn't our basketball coach; he's the PE teacher.
why: 是 is only ever negated with 不; 没是 does not exist.

zh: 今天没有比赛。
py: jīn tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài
en: There's no match today.
why: 没有 negates the noun 比赛, so it stands right before it, with the time word 今天 in front. 不有 would be wrong, as 有 only takes 没.

q: 我___坐过龙舟，听说很刺激。
zh: 我没坐过龙舟，听说很刺激。
py: wǒ méi zuò guo lóng zhōu tīng shuō hěn cì jī
en: I have never ridden in a dragon boat; I hear it's exciting.
why: 坐过 means 'have experienced', and its negative is always 没. 不坐过 is not possible.

q: 今年的春节一点儿也___热闹，街上几乎没有人。
zh: 今年的春节一点儿也不热闹，街上几乎没有人。
py: jīn nián de chūn jié yī diǎn r yě bù rè nao jiē shàng jī hū méi yǒu rén
en: This year's Spring Festival isn't lively at all; there's hardly anyone in the street.
why: 热闹 is an adjective, so 一点儿也不热闹. 没热闹 is not a possible phrase.

q: 我爱好摄影很多年了，可是还___拍过一张让自己满意的照片。
zh: 我爱好摄影很多年了，可是还没拍过一张让自己满意的照片。
py: wǒ ài hào shè yǐng hěn duō nián le kě shì hái méi pāi guo yī zhāng ràng zì jǐ mǎn yì de zhào piàn
en: I've loved photography for many years, but I still haven't taken one photo I'm happy with.
why: 还没 + verb + 过 says that up to now it has never happened. 还不拍过 is ungrammatical.

q: 今天的比赛___难，我们很容易就赢了。
zh: 今天的比赛不难，我们很容易就赢了。
py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài bù nán wǒ men hěn róng yì jiù yíng le
en: Today's match wasn't hard; we won easily.
why: 难 is an adjective describing a quality, so it takes 不 even when the match is already over. 没 is for events, not qualities.

s: 他昨天没参加比赛了。
zh: 他昨天没参加比赛。
py: tā zuó tiān méi cān jiā bǐ sài
en: He didn't take part in the match yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so the completion 了 must be dropped.
s_py: tā zuó tiān méi cān jiā bǐ sài le

q: 我的朋友都___愿意陪我去看龙舟比赛，他们说人太多。
zh: 我的朋友都不愿意陪我去看龙舟比赛，他们说人太多。
py: wǒ de péng you dōu bù yuàn yì péi wǒ qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài tā men shuō rén tài duō
en: None of my friends is willing to come with me to the dragon boat race; they say it is too crowded.
why: 愿意 is a modal of willingness and takes 不. 没愿意 is not used.

q: 你已经踢了三个小时了，___再踢了，休息一下吧。
zh: 你已经踢了三个小时了，别再踢了，休息一下吧。
py: nǐ yǐ jīng tī le sān ge xiǎo shí le bié zài tī le xiū xi yī xià ba
en: You've already played for three hours; stop playing and take a break.
why: 别...了 means 'stop doing it'. 没 and 不是 cannot be followed by 再 to say that.

zh: 明天我不去爬山。
py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù pá shān
en: I'm not going hiking tomorrow.
why: 不 goes right before the verb 去. The time word 明天 may come before or after 我, but 不 may not move.

q: 她不但___会骑马，而且连马都怕。
zh: 她不但不会骑马，而且连马都怕。
py: tā bù dàn bù huì qí mǎ ér qiě lián mǎ dōu pà
en: She not only can't ride a horse; she's even afraid of horses.
why: 不但不会 negates the modal 会 with 不. 没会 is never possible, in any construction.

s: 昨天不冷，我们去爬山了。
zh: 昨天不冷，我们去爬山了。
py: zuó tiān bù lěng wǒ men qù pá shān le
en: It wasn't cold yesterday, so we went hiking.
why: 冷 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even with 昨天. 没冷 would be the error.

s: 我没想到他会赢得这么轻松。
zh: 我没想到他会赢得这么轻松。
py: wǒ méi xiǎng dào tā huì yíng de zhè me qīng sōng
en: I didn't expect him to win so easily.
why: 没想到 is a fixed expression for 'didn't expect' (想到 reaches a result), so 没 is correct here although 想 alone is a modal that takes 不.

q: 我怎么说，弟弟就是___关电视。
zh: 我怎么说，弟弟就是不关电视。
py: wǒ zěn me shuō dì di jiù shì bù guān diàn shì
en: However I tell him, my younger brother simply refuses to turn off the TV.
why: 就是 + 不 shows stubborn refusal, which is 不. 没关 would only report that the TV was not turned off.

q: 明天下雨，我们___去爬山。
zh: 明天下雨，我们不去爬山。
py: míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men bù qù pá shān
en: It's going to rain tomorrow, so we won't go hiking.
why: 明天 is in the future, and a plan that will not happen is negated with 不. 没 only looks back at something that did not happen.

s: 你不用等我，先去踢球吧。
zh: 你不用等我，先去踢球吧。
py: nǐ bù yòng děng wǒ xiān qù tī qiú ba
en: You don't need to wait for me; go and play football first.
why: 不用 means 'no need to'. It is correct here, since the sentence offers permission and is not a prohibition.

q: 你的身体还没恢复，医生说你现在___应该参加长跑比赛。
zh: 你的身体还没恢复，医生说你现在不应该参加长跑比赛。
py: nǐ de shēn tǐ hái méi huī fù yī shēng shuō nǐ xiàn zài bù yīng gāi cān jiā cháng pǎo bǐ sài
en: You haven't recovered yet; the doctor says you shouldn't take part in the long-distance race now.
why: 应该 is a modal and takes 不: 不应该 + verb. 没应该 and 别应该 are both impossible.

q: 教练问我们周末去不去踢球，我说我___去，要复习。
zh: 教练问我们周末去不去踢球，我说我不去，要复习。
py: jiào liàn wèn wǒ men zhōu mò qù bu qù tī qiú wǒ shuō wǒ bù qù yào fù xí
en: The coach asked whether we'd go play football at the weekend; I said I'm not going because I have to revise.
why: The weekend is still ahead, so a decision not to go is 不去. 没去 would say that it did not happen.

q: 你有___有兴趣参加周末的羽毛球比赛？
zh: 你有没有兴趣参加周末的羽毛球比赛？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xìng qù cān jiā zhōu mò de yǔ máo qiú bǐ sài
en: Are you interested in joining the badminton match this weekend?
why: The A-not-A question of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is never said.

q: 老师说比赛的时候___可以用手机。
zh: 老师说比赛的时候不可以用手机。
py: lǎo shī shuō bǐ sài de shí hou bù kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī
en: The teacher said we may not use our phones during the match.
why: 可以 (permission) is negated with 不. Reported speech does not change that: 没可以 is not possible.

src_py: wǒ men míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài
zh: 我们明天没有比赛。
py: wǒ men míng tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài
en: We don't have a match tomorrow.
why: 有 becomes 没有 in every tense, even for tomorrow. 不有 does not exist.

q: 他昨天跑步跑得太累了，到现在还___睡醒。
zh: 他昨天跑步跑得太累了，到现在还没睡醒。
py: tā zuó tiān pǎo bù pǎo de tài lèi le dào xiàn zài hái méi shuì xǐng
en: He got too tired running yesterday and still hasn't woken up.
why: 还没睡醒 says the result (waking up) has not been reached yet, so 没 goes before the verb. 还不睡醒 is not a normal phrase.

q: 我从来___去过滑雪场。
zh: 我从来没去过滑雪场。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo huá xuě chǎng
en: I have never been to a ski resort.
why: 去过 is an experience, and its negative is 没去过. 不去过 is impossible because 过 never follows 不.

s: 他说得太快了，我听不懂。
zh: 他说得太快了，我听不懂。
py: tā shuō de tài kuài le wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand.
why: 听不懂 is the potential form 'cannot understand', with 不 between verb and result. It is correct and different from 没听懂.

q: 春节的北京很冷，上海___太冷。
zh: 春节的北京很冷，上海不太冷。
py: chūn jié de běi jīng hěn lěng shàng hǎi bù tài lěng
en: Beijing is cold at Spring Festival, but Shanghai isn't too cold.
why: 冷 is an adjective, so the negative is 不 (不太冷). 没 would suggest it had not yet turned cold.

src_py: nǐ kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ fàng yān huā
zh: 你不可以在这里放烟花。
py: nǐ bù kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ fàng yān huā
en: You may not set off fireworks here.
why: 可以 is a modal, so it is negated with 不 placed directly before it: 不可以. The place phrase may come before or after 不可以, but 没可以 is not possible.

q: 你找到你的球鞋了吗？——我___找到。
zh: 你找到你的球鞋了吗？——我没找到。
py: nǐ zhǎo dào nǐ de qiú xié le ma wǒ méi zhǎo dào
en: Did you find your sneakers? — No, I didn't find them.
why: The question asks whether the result was reached and the answer says it was not, so 没 comes before the verb: 没找到. 不找到 is not possible.

q: 过年的时候我们___要去亲戚家，想在家休息。
zh: 过年的时候我们不要去亲戚家，想在家休息。
py: guò nián de shí hou wǒ men bù yào qù qīn qi jiā xiǎng zài jiā xiū xi
en: At New Year we don't want to visit relatives; we'd rather rest at home.
why: 要 here means 'want to', a modal, so the negative is 不要 (don't want). 没要去 is not said.

s: 老师的话我不听懂。
zh: 老师的话我没听懂。
py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: A result that was not reached is 没 + verb + result. 不听懂 is not a form; 'can't understand' would be 听不懂.
s_py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ bù tīng dǒng

s: 我们好久没一起踢球了。
zh: 我们好久没一起踢球了。
py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi yī qǐ tī qiú le
en: We haven't played football together for a long time.
why: 好久没...了 is a fixed pattern for the time since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action, so the final 了 is correct.

s: 我不参加过马拉松。
zh: 我没参加过马拉松。
py: wǒ méi cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng
en: I have never taken part in a marathon.
why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now, so its negative is 没. 不参加过 is not possible.
s_py: wǒ bù cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng

q: 我怕水，所以从来___下河游泳。
zh: 我怕水，所以从来不下河游泳。
py: wǒ pà shuǐ suǒ yǐ cóng lái bù xià hé yóu yǒng
en: I'm afraid of water, so I never go swimming in the river.
why: 从来 + verb without 过 states a standing habit, which takes 不. 从来没 would need 过 to show an experience never had (从来没下过河).

q: 上个月我们没组织___郊游，大家都太忙了。
zh: 上个月我们没组织郊游，大家都太忙了。
py: shàng ge yuè wǒ men méi zǔ zhī jiāo yóu dà jiā dōu tài máng le
en: We didn't organize an outing last month; everyone was too busy.
why: 没组织郊游 has no 了, even though the time is clearly past. The 了 later in the sentence belongs to 太忙了, not to the negated verb.

s: 明年春节我没回家。
zh: 明年春节我不回家。
py: míng nián chūn jié wǒ bù huí jiā
en: I'm not going home next Spring Festival.
why: 明年 is in the future, and a plan not to do something is 不. 没 cannot refer to next year.
s_py: míng nián chūn jié wǒ méi huí jiā

q: 我没带___球拍，今天不能打球。
zh: 我没带球拍，今天不能打球。
py: wǒ méi dài qiú pāi jīn tiān bù néng dǎ qiú
en: I didn't bring my racket, so I can't play today.
why: 带球拍 is negated by 没, and 了 is dropped. 没带了球拍 is the classic error.

q: 这位运动员很有名，可是我以前___认识他。
zh: 这位运动员很有名，可是我以前不认识他。
py: zhè wèi yùn dòng yuán hěn yǒu míng kě shì wǒ yǐ qián bù rèn shi tā
en: This athlete is famous, but I didn't know him before.
why: 认识 is a state verb: it takes 不 even when 以前 puts it in the past.

s: 周末你有不有空去爬山？
zh: 周末你有没有空去爬山？
py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kòng qù pá shān
en: Are you free to go hiking at the weekend?
why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is never said.
s_py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu bu yǒu kòng qù pá shān

q: 我是素食者，所以平时___吃肉。
zh: 我是素食者，所以平时不吃肉。
py: wǒ shì sù shí zhě suǒ yǐ píng shí bù chī ròu
en: I'm a vegetarian, so I don't usually eat meat.
why: 平时 and the reason 素食者 show a standing habit, so 不. 没吃肉 would only say one meal had no meat.

q: 爷爷一向___放鞭炮，他说太吵，对耳朵不好。
zh: 爷爷一向不放鞭炮，他说太吵，对耳朵不好。
py: yé ye yí xiàng bù fàng biān pào tā shuō tài chǎo duì ěr duo bù hǎo
en: Grandpa never sets off firecrackers; he says they are too noisy and bad for the ears.
why: 一向 describes a lifelong habit, so 不. 没 would claim that on one particular occasion he did not do it.

q: 奶奶今年打算___回老家过中秋节。
zh: 奶奶今年打算不回老家过中秋节。
py: nǎi nai jīn nián dǎ suàn bù huí lǎo jiā guò zhōng qiū jié
en: Grandma plans not to go back to her hometown for the Mid-Autumn Festival this year.
why: 打算 looks forward, so the plan not to go is 不. 没 cannot follow a verb of intending, because nothing has happened yet.

q: 今天的灯会人太多了，我们挤___进去，只好在外面看。
zh: 今天的灯会人太多了，我们挤不进去，只好在外面看。
py: jīn tiān de dēng huì rén tài duō le wǒ men jǐ bù jìn qù zhǐ hǎo zài wài miàn kàn
en: There were too many people at today's lantern fair, so we couldn't squeeze in and had to watch from outside.
why: 'Couldn't get in' is the potential form 挤不进去, with 不 inside the complement. 挤没进去 does not exist.

q: 元宵节那天我没去___看灯。
zh: 元宵节那天我没去看灯。
py: yuán xiāo jié nà tiān wǒ méi qù kàn dēng
en: I didn't go to see the lanterns on Lantern Festival day.
why: With 没 the verb stays bare: 没去看灯. 去了 would be the positive 'went'.

q: 我昨天___看足球赛，我去逛街了。
zh: 我昨天没看足球赛，我去逛街了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn zú qiú sài wǒ qù guàng jiē le
en: I didn't watch the football match yesterday; I went shopping.
why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没. 不看 would mean refusing or not going to watch.

q: 他说他明天___来参加比赛。
zh: 他说他明天不来参加比赛。
py: tā shuō tā míng tiān bù lái cān jiā bǐ sài
en: He says he isn't coming to the match tomorrow.
why: 明天 means it has not happened yet, and a decision not to come is 不来. 没来 would report that he failed to show up.

q: 这里___可以游泳，水太深了。
zh: 这里不可以游泳，水太深了。
py: zhè lǐ bù kě yǐ yóu yǒng shuǐ tài shēn le
en: You can't swim here; the water is too deep.
why: 可以 is a modal verb and is negated with 不 (不可以 = not allowed). 没可以 does not exist.
